component: Shared Exchange protocol sender and operation-queue line status

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Before the initial HTTP retry loop, send_request repeatedly observes the error-handling line and waits on its shared receiver while Busy. The actual Line::status method returns Free or a cloned completion receiver without acquiring a token. This delays a new request behind an already active handler, while the later recovery/backoff branches separately acquire or reuse tokens. It does not serialize every request or reserve the line between a free observation and sending. Receiver failures propagate as protocol errors. The fixed accepted source retains this gate; no concurrent request, throttling, authentication or build test ran.
title: The request gate waits for an existing error handler without taking its token
